summary: For a disconnected build, create $HOME/custom-ee/files and an execution-environment.yml (version: 3) with a private hub ee-minimal base image, ansible.cfg, pip.conf and hub-ca.crt as build files, and prepend_base steps that use them.
questions: How do I point ansible-builder at my private automation hub?
How do I add a CA certificate to an execution environment build?
